title: RealRoute: Dynamic Query Routing System via Retrieve-then-Verify Paradigm
authors: Jiahe Liu; Qinkai Yu; Jingcheng Niu; Xi Zhu; Zirui He; Zhen Xiang; Fan Yang; Jinman Zhao
why_relevant: Proposes a retrieve-then-verify multi-source routing system to mitigate routing errors and aggregate evidence, tangentially related to retrieval control and evidence verification.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on multi-source routing for multi-hop QA, not on robustness to noise/conflict/adversaries/calibration in a principled way.
suggested_section: Calibration and control: when/where to retrieve
